Misplaced your card? Use Citi® Quick Lock in the Citi Mobile® App or at citi.com to instantly block new charges while allowing recurring transactions to continue without disruption.
24-hour fraud protection
Citi will alert you if we see unusual activity on your account.
Mastercard® ID Theft Protection
The ID Theft Protection program offered by Mastercard® helps eliminate the worry of identity theft by monitoring the information you choose to protect and alerting you if suspicious activity is found. It takes just a few minutes to enroll for free, and as soon as you do, your monitoring begins. Visit mastercardidps.idprotectiononline.com to learn more.
Contactless pay
Shop safely with a contactless chip-enabled card. Just tap your card on the payment reader and go in seconds.Card managementAutomatic account alerts
Stay updated on balance, payments and credit limits via email or text.
Choose your payment due date
Choose to pay your bill on any available due date in the beginning, middle or end of the month. Enjoy the flexibility of paying your full balance or just the minimum payment due each month.
Paperless statements and e-communications
Reduce clutter and get your statements and most legal notices online instead of in the mail.
24/7 Customer Service
To save time and manage your account from anywhere, download the Citi Mobile® App. You can handle most of your banking needs right from your phone, 24/7.ConvenienceCiti Mobile® App
Manage your account when you want, where you want and the way you want. It's how Citi digital services help you get the most out of your time.
Digital wallets
Digital wallets let you shop with confidence in millions of places online, within apps and in stores. With digital wallets you can speed through checkout and continue to enjoy all the great benefits that come with your card. Learn how to get started and how digital wallets can help protect your card information at citi.com/digitalservices.
Access FICO® Score
Get free access to your FICO® Score online to review your credit history.LifestyleCiti Entertainment®
Citi Entertainment® is an entertainment access program available to eligible Citi® credit card and Citibank® Debit Card customers. Citi cardmembers get special access to purchase tickets to thousands of events, including presale tickets and exclusive experiences to the year's most anticipated concerts, sporting events, arts and culture experiences.
Citi Travel®
With Citi Travel®, you can book flights, hotels, car rentals and attractions using your eligible Citi card, points or a combination of both. Citi Travel offers access to over 1.4 million hotels and resorts available worldwide.
Points transfer
Points transfer to American Airlines, JetBlue, Virgin Atlantic, Cathay, Eva Air, Choice Hotels, The Leading Hotels of the World® and others. The minimum transfer is only 1,000 points.
Citi® Flex Pay
Buy now, pay later with Citi® Flex Pay. Pay over time in fixed monthly payments and continue to earn points on purchases. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more.2Explore the family of Strata CardsDiscover a range of credit cards tailored to your passions and priorities. Explore our collection of Citi Strata Credit Cards. Learn more FAQsWhat are the benefits of the Citi Strata Elite® Card?The Citi Strata Elite® Card offers several benefits, including the ability to enjoy rewards through the ThankYou® Rewards program:
12X points on Hotels, Car Rentals, and Attractions booked through cititravel.com
6X points on Air Travel booked through cititravel.com
6X points at Restaurants on Citi Nights® purchases (Friday and Saturday from 6 p.m. – 6 a.m. ET)
3X points at Restaurants at any other time2
1.5X points on All Other Purchases2
Enjoy an Annual Hotel Benefit, complimentary Priority Pass Select membership, and the opportunity to earn statement credits on Blacklane purchases and more. Plus, every calendar year, you will receive four Admirals Club® Citi Strata Elite® Passes for access to nearly 50 Admirals Club® lounges.2
Complimentary Priority Pass™ Select membership
Travel protection benefits2:
Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption (Common Carrier)
Trip Delay
Lost or Damaged Luggage
MasterRental Coverage (Car Rental)
Additional benefits of this travel credit card include no foreign transaction fees on purchases1, as well as Points transfer to American Airlines, JetBlue, Virgin Atlantic, Cathay, Eva Air, Choice Hotels, The Leading Hotels of the World®, and others.What is the Annual Fee for the Citi Strata Elite® Card?The Annual Fee is $595.1How does the Annual Hotel Benefit work?Once per calendar year, you can enjoy $300 off a single hotel stay of 2 nights or more (excluding taxes and fees) booked through cititravel.com. The benefit is applied instantly at the time of booking.Are there foreign transaction fees for the Citi Strata Elite® Card?There are no foreign transaction fees1 with the Citi Strata Elite® Card.How do you redeem ThankYou® Points with the Citi Strata Elite® Card?You can easily redeem ThankYou® Points online or by calling the ThankYou Service Center. You can also use ThankYou® Points for travel at cititravel.com.
If you choose to redeem online, visit thankyou.com to view the entire rewards collection available through the ThankYou® Rewards program. Upon login, there are several ways you can browse and redeem for rewards:
The main Rewards page presents all categories. Simply select the type of reward you're interested in to see what the collection has to offer.
Browse by specific points ranges.
Use the search tool to find specific items in the collection.
Add any desired item to your cart. After your order has been placed, a confirmation email will be sent to confirm that the redemption was successful.
If you choose to redeem points by calling the ThankYou Service Center at 1-800-THANKYOU (1-800-842-6596), please note that only select items are redeemable by phone. For speech or hearing impaired TTY: We accept 711 or other Relay Service.Is the Citi Strata Elite® Card a Mastercard® or Visa® Credit Card?The Citi Strata Elite® Card is a Mastercard®.What credit score is needed to qualify for the Citi Strata Elite® Card?There are many factors that Citi uses to determine creditworthiness, including your credit score. For Citi Flex Plans subject to an APR, the variable APR is 20.74% - 28.74%, based on creditworthiness. For Citi Flex Pay Plans subject to a Plan Fee, a monthly fee of up to 1.72% will apply, based on the Citi Flex Plan duration, the APR that would otherwise apply to the Transaction, and other factors. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The variable penalty APR is up to 29.99% and may be applied if you make a late payment or make a payment that is returned. Minimum interest charge – $0.50. Annual fee - $595. Annual fee for Authorized Users - $75. Fee for foreign purchases - None. Cash advance fee - either $10 or 5% of the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee — either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. New cardmembers only. Subject to credit approval. Additional limitations, terms and conditions apply.
